QuestInfo.name: Catch the Cat Burglar
QuestInfo.0: Cat burglars are more active during the holiday season.
QuestInfo.1: It's been reported that cat burglars are hiding as balls of yarn amongst the monsters... \r\n\r\n#e#b(You'll lose 3 dice if you forfeit the quest.)#k#n
QuestInfo.2: Now no one needs to worry during the holidays!

mob.0: The Street Cats are masters of disguise. They're hiding amongst monsters, disguised as balls of yarn. When you encounter a Ball of Yarn while you're fighting monsters, #rdouble-click#k it and investigate. You might find a Street Cat inside!
